title: buchanania axillaris
intro: Buchanania axillaris, commonly known as the Indian plum or Elephant's apple, is a species of flowering plant in the Anacardiaceae family. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties and is known to have various health benefits, including treating diarrhea, dysentery, and skin conditions due to its anti-inflammatory and antibacterial properties. The therapeutic actions of Buchanania axillaris include its ability to act as an astringent, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial agent, making it useful in treating a range of conditions. The bioactive constituents present in this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
